title: IPv6 SLAAC and Neighbor Discovery
summary: Configure IPv6 Stateless Address Autoconfiguration (SLAAC) on Cisco IOS, observe ICMPv6 Router Advertisements, verify host prefix autoconfiguration, and audit the IPv6 Neighbor Discovery cache.
learning_objectives: Explain the mechanics of IPv6 Stateless Address Autoconfiguration (SLAAC) and ICMPv6 Router Advertisements (Type 134) per RFC 4862
Configure global IPv6 routing and interface addressing on a Cisco IOS gateway router using 'ipv6 unicast-routing'
Configure end-host clients to automatically obtain IPv6 Global Unicast Addresses (GUA) and default gateways via SLAAC
Verify end-to-end IPv6 reachability across local host interfaces and remote diagnostic subnets using ICMPv6 echo requests
Audit and interpret the Cisco IOS IPv6 Neighbor Discovery cache using 'show ipv6 neighbors' across reachability states
Diagnose IPv6 autoconfiguration failures caused by missing global unicast routing and suppressed router advertisements

source.origin: Independently authored IPv6 address autoconfiguration and neighbor discovery curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 4861 and RFC 4862 standards
